examples.en: She listened carefully without uttering a syllable.
examples.vi: Cô ấy chăm chú lắng nghe mà không thốt ra một lời nào.

senses.vi: chữ; lời

thesaurus.definition: a unit of spoken language larger than a phoneme

wiktionary.gloss: A unit of human speech which often forms words corresponding to one opening of the mouth; a vowel and its surrounding consonants.
The written representation of a given pronounced syllable.
A small part of a sentence or discourse; anything concise or short; a particle.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English syllable, sillable, syllabylle, sylabul, from Anglo-Norman sillable, from Old French sillebe, from Latin syllaba, from Ancient Greek συλλαβή (sullabḗ), from συλλαμβάνω (sullambánō, “to gather together”), from συν- (sun-, “together”) + λαμβάνω (lambánō, “to take”).

wiktionary.gloss: To utter in syllables.

idioms.gloss: In simple, clear, straightforward language; in blunt language.

wiktionary.gloss: Of or pertaining to theurgy.

examples: With a theurgical flourish, he pulled a rabbit from the hat.
wiktionary.gloss: Of or pertaining to magic.
Feeling exhausted; out of energy due to exhaustion.

blocks.etymology: Calque of translingual Odontoceti. By surface analysis, toothed + whale.

thesaurus.definition: any of several whales having simple conical teeth and feeding on fish etc.

wiktionary.gloss: Any of the parvorder Odontoceti of cetaceans that have teeth instead of baleen, including sperm whales, beaked whales, dolphins, and others.

vi_block: Ba màu; ba màu hợp thành.

wiktionary.gloss: Containing three atoms of chromium.
Having three colours; trichromatic.

thesaurus.definition: meter for measuring the quantity of water passing through a particular outlet

wiktionary.gloss: A device used to measure the volume of water usage.
A device used to measure evaporation.
An extremely long time ago; long before living memory.
